intake.client_name: Estate of Mabel R. Thornquist (Eleanor Thornquist-Reddick, PR)
intake.matter_summary: Flat-fee estate planning for Mabel R. Thornquist — a new will and explanatory letter (2024) — and defense of the resulting will against a contest brought by the decedent's son alleging lack of capacity and undue influence.

conflicts_check.notes: No adverse-client conflict identified at intake. Flagged for the file: because the firm drafted and supervised execution of the will, the drafting attorney is a potential witness if the will is later contested; the advocate-witness question is to be revisited at that time.

time_entries.narrative: Initial estate-planning consultation and intake; review of prior 2015 will and current family circumstances.
Private meeting with client alone; confirmed dispositive wishes and reasons for departure from equal split.
Draft last will and testament and companion explanatory letter; coordinate capacity examination and disinterested attesting witness.
Supervise execution of will and explanatory letter; two witnesses and self-proving affidavit; prepare contemporaneous file memorandum.
Petition for probate; secure order admitting will and appointment of personal representative.
Review contestant's objection and petition to contest; docket response deadline; preliminary issue analysis.
Interview personal representative regarding contest; capacity, caregiving, finances, and family history.
Obtain witness statements from attesting witness, treating physician, and home health aide.
Analyze advocate-witness question given firm's drafting role; memorandum on how to staff any contested hearing.
Draft response to objection and petition to contest; assemble supporting exhibits.
